# Shapes

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Factory methods that draw common shapes onto a canvas path.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Drawing`.

## Methods

- [`Circle`](#circle): Adds a circle path centered at (`cx`, `cy`).
- [`Diamond`](#diamond): Adds a diamond (rotated square) path.
- [`RegularPolygon`](#regularpolygon): Adds a regular polygon path.
- [`RoundedRect`](#roundedrect): Adds a rounded rectangle path.
- [`Star`](#star): Adds a star path with the given number of points.
